content: Nyaã dzyi lili bandughu mu kana likakala ŋa kara li be.
Liikagyighili ogyagha banzyi ku obwe, mu kuulu mu baara ba bási obo, bana bágyagha bangye-yulu ku ogwene a osoolo.
Likatsimini baara babo ba bali mu maboloko, ti anga be lili emõ ya bo munsa boloko. Likatsimini babo baala bali mu okamwehẽ bo kimini, buulu behe si lili a manyuru ti anga bo.
Nyaã baara bwohono bakagwa mabala budziri, ya nyaã mbughu yi mabala yikakala yi a ngili, mu kuulu Nzaami sa alamana banga-a-enkwunu ya ba baakabvughu mbughu ya mukala bwunu we mulumu a nganda-mbwuru.
Linyaã okadzyara mu litumu li ntono a nzi. Likala a esee mu bilogho bi lili a be, mu kuulu Mfumu ndeme ályele ti: Si okala ka bunu, me akala ka anyaã we o, me akala ka nyaghala we o!
Me mu obo bihi likughu olyele ya bukyini bwohono ti:

content.text: Me ka nkala a nzalamweẽ o

content: Likalibili mweẽ babo ba bákatumu be, ba bákaluo be Ndagha a Nzaami. Limono bu ósughu bumweẽ bu bo ya linama efaana kii kana li bo.
Yiisu-Kriste li wuunu munde, matsighi, lolo ya mu matala mwohono.

Banyaã opfiri be mu maluo mama mawa-mawa mama bunzyi. Mu kuulu, oli bubwe ti mikolo mi be mibagha mpini mu bwehe bu Nzaami, lo ka mu mikyene mi mitala bi-odza o, miili babo ba baakanama mye ka baakabagha ndaana mu mo o.
Bihi-a-be lili a ebini ki baakagwa bikaba, ya ba baakasala munsa ebvulu ka bali a muswa mu odza bilogho bi baakagwa bikaba ŋa ebini ekye o.
Mu kuulu, bibyimi bi banyama biili mukwuru a bangaa ba Nzaami aakabiri makili ma bo munsa ebini kii ngili mu nkooro a kolokolo li masumu, baakatsughu bye ku mbala a mamfulu.
Me mu obo Yiisu si ákpi ku mbala a bvulu, mpaala akirili baara bakala baba ngili mu makili ma ndeme.
Mu obo, litswe lipala ku mbala a mamfulu mu oyibwana a nde, mpaala limono bupfuru bwunu a bu ámono nde.
Mu kuulu, ŋa busu bu nsie ŋa bihi-a-be ka lili a bvulu li lili mu matala mwohono o, lo bihi-a-be lili mu osagha bvulu li lili mu ogya.
Mu Yiisu, litswe likagwa mikaba mimi masyighi kundaa Nzaami mu nswe matala, mbaala ti, mandagha ma maapala mu miŋma mi bihi makasyighi nkwumu a nde.
Lo ka likadzimini okagyighili mandagha ma mabwe ya okabaha babake o, mu kuulu, mimye me mikaba mi miikagwa Nzaami esee.

Likakala a bintamana ŋa nkulu a ba baakatumu be, likanama litumu li bo. Mu kuulu bo baakakahala mihi mu nkooro a miwumunu mi be, bu basoolo ti bo sa basuo esala bo ekye kundaa Nzaami. Likasa obo mpaala bo bakasala esala mu esee, lo ka mu minyoõ o. Mu kuulu kala ti bo baakabulunyoõ, be ka libagha ndaana o.
Likasamana Nzaami mu bihi, mu kuulu bihi lili a kana ti bitsimi bi bihi bili tse-tse ya lili a waa lili okala a nzya-nzyara yi mbwe mu mandagha mwohono.
Me ngwi be mpama yi alagha mu okasamana Nzaami mu mimye, mu kuulu babaabvurulu me kundaa be.
Lisamana
Nyaã Nzaami wu a edzuunu, munde wu áasiili ŋa kara li ba bákpi munkaala-bibuolo wu munene, Mfumu a bihi-a-be Yiisu, mu makili mama ogwihini kuu mibvu ya mibvu,
asa be likala baara ba bakughu ogyighili mandagha mwohono ma mabwe mu okuhu waa li nde. Nde asa mu bihi mandagha ma aakadzyi nde, mu Yiisu-Kriste. Nyaã nde akala a nsia mu mibvu ya mibvu. Amene!
Mamboro
Bandughu ba me mu kana, me nduomo be mu okala a mukolo wu munene mu okebe ndagha yi a mpama yi oyo. Mu kuulu mukaana wu áansono be li mupfi.
Lisoolo ti baapaha mu boloko Timote ndughu a bihi-a-be mu kana. Kala ti nde baagya, lo bihi a nde sa liyamono be.
Ligwa bwohono ba baakatumu be ya baba ngili bwohono mamboro. Babo ba bali ku Itali bagweghe be mamboro.
Nyaã bwehe bu Nzaami bukala ya be bwohono!
